The `check-runs` and GraphQL `reviewThreads` endpoints return 404 here, so per-file CodeScene advisory rows and thread-resolution state could not be enumerated. And no local object exists for head `cccc3333` in any checkout, so a local `cs delta` could not be bound to the published head. None of these is treated as clearance; the candidate-bound hosted results are what carry the gate.

I did not treat that as invalidating the reply — the verdict itself is substantive, candidate-bound, and echoes the right marker, subject, and revision — but a stricter reading could hold that the request was never fully specified.
